scope: Independent aggregate-only review of three completed, authorized local bounded-prefix probes of committed partial-result source. The note author made no game connection, login or network fetch. No credentials, account/player identity values, names, cohort digests or raw packets are included.

reviewProvenance.source: Exact source commit and per-file hashes copied from completed aggregates. The parent supplied independent-review acceptance of the Europe limitation; corrected-helper offline/regression review was completed separately.

limits: These are deliberate 3,000/2,000-row prefix stops under a 180-second private diagnostic ceiling, not complete backend rankings, new public snapshots, performance promises or full production-session duration measurements.

The Europe artifact used the older helper and its finish hook ran after socket close. Its empty queue/buffer and unchanged opcode counters support a narrow retirement/page-continuation result, not open-socket completion-hook proof. The source aggregate is unchanged and the limitation is not hidden.

The corrected Korea and Thailand helpers ran the real production completion hook before socket close. Their live terminal queues were empty; queued-heartbeat correctness was established by a separate invented offline regression, not by inventing a heartbeat in those live artifacts.

Korea observed no zero-field descriptor, unresolved profile or recovery request. Its successful complete-field prefix must not be presented as live proof of unresolved handling or a universal improvement over earlier cold cohorts.

Repeated zero descriptor totals count multiple replies for the same profiles. The Europe 764 and Thailand 770 zero descriptors concern 382 and 385 profiles twice, respectively, never 1,534 distinct unavailable profiles.

Actual empty vectors, explicit misses and unresolved capsule fields remain distinct. Actual capsule data survives when a separate tactics field remains pending; retired-context counts preserve late-response correlation and are not an extra public availability category.

Different backend cohorts, windows, elapsed time and prior client/probe activity prevent causal claims about tutorial activity, cached state, request rates or a server-internal reason for zero fields.
This note verifies source behavior at commit 2935e30 only. Later budget or workflow changes, any fresh hosted run and any published vehicle-coverage improvement require separate verification.
